title: Ampersand Coalition Declaration (CC2)
description: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 for CC2 coalition declarations in the [&] Protocol. A coalition lifts CC1 single-agent composition to a group: agents pool typed capabilities and coordinate to ENSURE a goal, with each task owned, shared facts common knowledge, the joint run supervised, and a safety floor none may weaken. Each clause maps to a rung of the box-and-box modality ladder (the verdict engine). CC1 is the special case of a singleton coalition with an empty adversary.

$schema.description: Canonical schema identifier for coalition declarations.

agents.description: The members of the coalition. A singleton ([self]) is the CC1 special case. (Rung: alethic — the joint capability set is the lattice join of the members' sets.)

ensure.description: The goal the coalition must be ABLE to force against the worst case of any non-member (strategic.canEnsure, ⟨⟨agents⟩⟩◊). ought-implies-can: a coalition MUST NOT be bound to a goal it cannot force; if it cannot, it escalates (recruit agents, or weaken the goal).

adversary.description: Non-member agents whose worst-case behavior the coalition must ensure the goal against. Empty (the default) is the CC1 special case. (Rung: strategic.)

common_knowledge.description: Facts that MUST be common knowledge among the agents for the joint strategy to be executable (the coordinated-attack result). The runtime's broadcast mechanism establishes this before the pipeline runs. (Rung: epistemic.common.)

owns.title: Task Ownership
owns.description: A total function from each owning agent to the task it is obligated for. No task may be unowned (responsibility diffusion is forbidden); conflicting obligations are resolved by deontic priority before enactment. Omitted for a singleton coalition (single owner = the sole agent). (Rung: deontic OBLIGATORY, owner-tagged.)

additionalProperties.description: The task identifier the agent owns and is obligated for.

shield.description: Safety (and liveness) formulas over the JOINT trajectory the compose pipeline can produce. A reachable safety violation makes the coalition inadmissible; a liveness goal that fails at the horizon becomes a coalition obligation with contrary-to-duty escalation. (Rung: temporal.supervise.)

floor.description: Entrenched constraints no agent or sub-coalition can weaken, even under learning. The coalition MAY revise everything else (and SHOULD, as it learns) but MUST NOT weaken the floor. (Rung: reflexive.entrench — monotone, un-weakenable.)

compose.description: The cross-agent governed pipeline (the lifted |>): a sequential, associative, non-commutative composition whose hand-offs must be type-compatible or the composed value annihilates to 0̲. Quantities (cost as sum, confidence as product, latency as max) compose end-to-end. (Rung: alethic value.chain + axiological semiring.)

provenance.description: When true, conforming implementations attach hash-linked provenance records to coalition verdicts and the pipeline's joint trajectory.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: Human-readable name or identifier (agent, coalition, or task).
